what_to_detect: A face-down manifested permanent whose card has morph can be turned face up for its morph cost: the Morph turn-face-up candidate of a face-down permanent is playable.
near_miss: A face-down permanent's Morph turn-face-up candidate that is not playable.
record_fields: snapshot entity face_down of the candidate's source
Forge's Morph keyword instance owns both the cast-face-down spell and the turn-face-up action, so keyword Morph alone also tags every face-down cast from hand
